The cited L. 842-3 delegates the minimum PA payment amount to decree, but the permitted pinned source texts do not include that amount. The 15 EUR figure appearing in a case boundary is not treated as a source.

The supplied source snippets do not establish the L. 521-1 AF payment duty, the AAH location in the cited CSS book title, or all carry-forward priority and prescription inputs; answers state conditional arithmetic and pending facts rather than presuming them.
Fund-stated bases, allocations, debt balances, rates, and effective household classifications are treated as case inputs, not independently established statutory amounts.
